families.title: Precision
families.description: Compact controls, fine dividers and restrained type for working tools.
families.tradeoff: Compact controls need careful touch spacing.

families.title: Editorial
families.description: Serif headlines, generous reading space and quiet controls.
families.tradeoff: Serif headings are less suited to dense numeric controls.

families.title: Marketplace
families.description: Roomy controls, open cards and welcoming rounded shapes.
families.tradeoff: Roomy controls show fewer records at once.

families.title: Tactile
families.description: Inset edges, layered shadows and controls with physical depth.
families.tradeoff: Shadows need consistent surface contrast. Optional audio may be unavailable.

families.title: Industrial
families.description: Square geometry, strong rules and geometric typography.
families.tradeoff: Keep decorative Doto type in titles, with the existing body fonts for reading.

families.title: Glass
families.description: Translucent layers, soft edges and luminous surface depth.
families.tradeoff: Contrast depends on the backdrop; blur adds rendering cost.

families.title: Neutral
families.description: Quiet surfaces, balanced spacing and unobtrusive controls.
families.tradeoff: Quiet surfaces provide less visual emphasis by default.

families.title: Expressive
families.description: Emphatic controls, layered surfaces and a stronger visual rhythm.
families.tradeoff: Keep status colors distinct from the primary action color.
